what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Angola in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 16983 asylum seekers from Angola.
The United States hosts the largest share, 40.1%, followed by France, Brazil and Mexico.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Angola with UNITA in 1995 and from 1998 to 2002, at war level in some of those years.
It also records armed conflict over Cabinda territory in many years, most recently with FLEC-FAC-TN in 2022 and 2024 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 5489 asylum seekers, and the figure fell to a low in 2009.
It then rose again, reaching its highest point, 22824, at the end of 2023; the main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2003 and 2020 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Angola are counted separately.
